digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolution
propositions: Define three class-level slots (trivial, standard, frontier) with model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array fields; validate that api_key is forbidden and no fallback entry is nested or recursive

Parse class slots from the [tool.rebar.llm] config table via CLI override, env vars, config file, or documented defaults, respecting the existing precedence chain (CLI > env > file > default) on a per-field basis

Implement a resolver that maps class names to provider-qualified model strings, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted, and returning documented defaults (frontier: claude-opus-4-8, standard: claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial: claude-haiku-4-5) when a slot is unset

Expose load_class_slots() in model_classes.py as the single named entry point that reads the real config, parses and validates the shape, and carries the fallback array on the record for runtime consumption by downstream tasks

Support environment variables for each slot field (e.g. REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_PROVIDER) that override corresponding config-file values while keeping the import edge one-way (model_classes imports from config, not vice versa)

Validate that fallback entries follow the same schema as slots minus the fallback key itself, reject api_key and nested fallback at both slot and entry level, and treat empty fallback array identically to absent fallback key
